registeredBaseline.source: Authenticated Google Ads UI readback immediately before this release

pilot.reason: Lifting facial is the declared strategic priority. The pilot is intentionally bounded because accepted qualified-conversion volume in Google Ads is not yet proven.

preconditions: Authenticated live readback matches account 995-334-4486 and campaign 24028216444.
G26LIFT is active, at R$ 24/day, on Maximize clicks, without a target CPA or shared budget.
The campaign still uses the qualified-lead goal and its conversion action is eligible for bidding.
All other budgets total R$ 75/day so the exact post-change account total is R$ 105/day.
No unreviewed draft, experiment, recommendation or concurrent change touches G26LIFT.
Current conversion acceptance and recent spend are captured without assuming that ready LEADS rows were accepted by Google.
executionSequence: Reread the full precondition set without writing.
Change only G26LIFT bidding to Maximize conversions, leaving target CPA unset.
Change only G26LIFT average daily budget from R$ 24 to R$ 30.
Save, then reread campaign ID, bidding strategy, target CPA, budget, goal and status.
Reread every campaign budget and confirm the exact account total of R$ 105/day.
Inspect change history and automatic-application settings for unintended writes.
preserved: the other seven campaign budgets and bid strategies
G26LIFT campaign, ad groups, keywords, negatives and search terms
qualified-lead goal and all conversion actions
Search network only, with Display and search partners disabled
São Paulo by presence, language, ages including Unknown, devices and schedule
RSAs, pins, URLs, tracking parameters, sitelinks and other assets
site, Netlify, Apps Script, LEADS, CRM, WhatsApp, Calendar and Meta
notApplied: Maximize clicks or target impression share recommendations on other campaigns
Display inclusion, search partners, Performance Max or optimized targeting
automatic RSA text generation or automatic keyword removal
store-visit goals or new conversion actions

monitoring.integrity: immediately after save and again in 24–48 hours
monitoring.business: D+7, D+14 and D+28 from verified activation

rollback.trigger: Unexpected target CPA, budget other than R$ 30, total other than R$ 105, goal/tracking failure, unintended concurrent setting, or sustained downstream/spend regression with healthy measurement.
rollback.action: Restore only G26LIFT to Maximize clicks without CPC cap and R$ 24/day, then reread it and the R$ 99/day account total. Preserve all history and unrelated changes.
